name: 出血卡片輪播（分隔線框出卡片、兩側箭頭與分頁點）
desc: 延伸到畫面左右邊緣的卡片輪播，中間完整露出三張、兩側露出被裁切的相鄰卡片；卡片以分隔線區隔，下方兩側箭頭、中間分頁點。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊是多個項目的輪播，延伸到畫面左右邊緣：畫面中間完整露出三個等寬、等高的項目，左右兩側各露出相鄰項目的一部分，被畫面邊緣裁切。項目循環排列：最後一個項目之後接回第一個，第一個項目之前接著最後一個，所以任何時候（包括一開始還沒切換時）畫面左右兩側都有相鄰項目，不會出現空位。每個項目上緣和下緣各有一條橫向分隔線，相鄰項目的橫線彼此斷開；相鄰項目之間有一條直向分隔線；項目本身沒有外框或底色。每個項目上方置中放一張直式圖片，約佔項目寬度的三分之二；圖片下方置中放標題，再下方是靠左的說明文字（可多行）；項目最下方置中放一個文字連結，固定在項目底部，和說明文字之間留較大空白。輪播下方是一列切換控制：左箭頭按鈕靠近畫面左緣、右箭頭按鈕靠近畫面右緣，中間置中一排分頁點，標示目前的項目。輪播會自動播放，每個項目停留數秒，也可用箭頭或分頁點切換，每次切換一個項目，切到最後一個之後繼續接回第一個。
mobile: 改為一次完整露出一個項目並置中，左右兩側各露出相鄰項目的一部分，被畫面邊緣裁切；項目仍循環排列，任何時候（包括一開始）左右兩側都有相鄰項目，不會出現空位；項目內部結構與分隔線不變。切換控制維持同一列：左右箭頭在兩側，分頁點置中。

en.name: Bleeding card carousel (divider-framed cards, side arrows and dots)
en.desc: A card carousel extending to the left and right edges of the viewport, showing three full cards in the middle and cropped neighbors on both sides; cards are separated by dividers, with arrows at both sides and pagination dots in the middle below.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section is a carousel of multiple items that extends to the left and right edges of the viewport: three equal-width, equal-height items are fully visible in the middle, and part of the neighboring item peeks in on each side, cropped by the viewport edge. The items are arranged in a loop: the first item follows the last one and the last item precedes the first one, so at any time (including at the start, before any switch) there is a neighboring item on both the left and right sides, with no empty slots. Each item has a horizontal divider along its top edge and another along its bottom edge, and the horizontal dividers of neighboring items are separated by a break; a vertical divider runs between neighboring items; the items themselves have no frame or background. At the top of each item, centered, is a portrait image taking about two thirds of the item's width; below the image is a centered title, and below that a left-aligned description (may wrap to multiple lines); at the very bottom of the item is a centered text link, fixed to the bottom of the item, with a fairly large space between it and the description. Below the carousel is a row of controls: the left arrow button sits near the left edge of the viewport and the right arrow button near the right edge, with a row of pagination dots centered between them marking the current item. The carousel autoplays, staying on each item for a few seconds, and can also be switched with the arrows or the dots, one item per switch, continuing from the last item back to the first.
en.mobile: Shows one full item at a time, centered, with part of the neighboring item peeking in on each side, cropped by the viewport edge; the items still loop, so at any time (including at the start) there is a neighboring item on both sides, with no empty slots; the item's inner structure and dividers are unchanged. The controls stay in one row: the arrows at both sides and the dots centered.
